The ECB's euro foreign exchange reference rates (eurofxref), as the ECB published them on
2026-11-06 (from ducat's first ECB parser, commit 8e38d82):

- `eurofxref-daily.xml`: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-daily.xml
- `eurofxref-hist-2d.xml`: https://www.ecb.europa.eu/stats/eurofxref/eurofxref-hist-90d.xml, cut to
  two days
- `eurofxref.csv` and `eurofxref-hist.csv`: the CSV files in the ECB's eurofxref zips, the history
  cut to a few days

Source: European Central Bank. ECB data may be reused free of charge with attribution (as recorded
when the files were added, commit c7eb41d).
